lines.speaker: annex_staffer
lines.text: Nothing shredded. And the register goes to the national archive tonight with a chain of custody attached, which is the important half: once a document has a custody chain it cannot quietly stop existing, it can only be visibly destroyed, and nobody wants to be the name on that form.

lines.speaker: annex_staffer
lines.text: Nine of us in this office and one tabled amendment between us. That number went up today. Go and talk to Okafor's old clerk — she will sit with your people, and she is better at this than all nine of us together.
